app.tagline: The price before, the proof after.

onboarding.welcomeText: Describe what you want in your own words. You see the price before anything starts, and you get proof that it works at the end.
onboarding.claudeOld: Claude Code {{version}} is too old. Please update it.
onboarding.claudeMissing: Claude Code is not installed yet. Automatic installation arrives in the next version; for now, install it from the official page.
onboarding.connectTitle: How do you pay for Claude?
onboarding.apiKeyDesc: Pay per use on your Anthropic account. Quotes are shown in money.
onboarding.subscriptionDesc: Use your Pro or Max plan. Quotes are shown as a share of your usage window.
onboarding.keyHelp: It is stored in your computer's secure keychain, never in a file.
onboarding.keyInvalid: This does not look like an Anthropic key (it starts with sk-ant-).
onboarding.signInWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser…
onboarding.signInLink: The browser did not open? Open the sign-in page
onboarding.claudeMissingAuto: Claude Code is not installed yet. Baguette can install it for you with Anthropic's official installer.

project.pickText: Pick an existing project, or an empty folder to start a new one.
project.memoryEmpty: Nothing remembered yet. Answers you give are kept so you are never asked twice.

task.composeTitle: What do you want to do?
task.composePlaceholder: For example: a website for my bakery with opening hours, products and a contact form.
task.composeHint: Plain words are fine. A few questions follow if needed.
task.example2: Add a contact form to my site
task.example3: Fix the bug in the login page
task.grillIntro: Your answers change the result. They are remembered for this project.
task.planning: Writing the brief and the quote…
task.estimateNote: Estimate based on the task size.
task.estimateUnmeasured: Your subscription's exact capacity is not known yet: the share is an estimate.
task.capOk: Within your cap. The task is stopped automatically if it reaches {{cap}}.
task.capWarn: The quote may reach your cap ({{cap}}): the task would then be stopped.
task.capBlocked: This quote is above what is left in your cap ({{cap}}). Raise the cap in Settings or make the request smaller.
task.retryHint: Claude goes back to work on the failed checks only.
task.retryPro: Automatic fixing is a Pro feature.
task.denialsText: These irreversible actions were refused. You can allow them in Settings.
task.failedRun: Claude Code could not finish the task.
task.manualChecklist: Tick each point yourself. Automatic checks with proof come with Pro.
task.undoConfirm: Put the project back as it was before this task?
task.leaksText: These lines look like a secret or sensitive personal data. Remove them before you share or publish the project.
task.screensHint: Taken during the check. The reviewer used these pictures for the visual criteria.

event.rateLimited: Usage limit reached; it resets at {{time}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modeHelp: Beginner explains everything simply. Expert shows the prompt and engine settings.
settings.carefulDesc: Edits files; only runs tests and builds.
settings.balancedDesc: Edits files and runs commands, except irreversible ones.
settings.autopilotDesc: Claude Code's auto mode decides, irreversible actions stay blocked.
settings.capsHelp: A task is stopped as soon as it reaches a cap.
settings.irreversibleHelp: Blocked by default. Allow only what you really need.
settings.allowDeploy: Put a site or app online
settings.screenshotsHelp: During the check, the page is opened in a hidden browser and photographed. The reviewer uses the pictures for visual criteria. They stay on your computer.
settings.autoRetry: If a criterion fails, fix it automatically once
settings.autoRetryHelp: Claude Code continues in the same session with the reviewer's findings. Your caps still apply.

errors.claude_not_found: Claude Code was not found on this computer.
errors.not_signed_in: Claude Code is not signed in, or the session expired. Sign in again in Settings.
errors.no_api_key: No API key yet. Add one in Settings.
errors.subscription_disabled: The subscription mode is temporarily unavailable. Use an API key.
errors.claude_failed: Claude Code stopped with an error.
errors.bad_structured_output: Claude's answer could not be read. Please try again.
errors.invalid: This action is not possible right now.
errors.secret_store: The secure keychain could not be used.

health.title: Health
health.intro: Baguette checks Claude Code, your connection, Git and your connectors, and fixes what it can.
health.confirmRemove: Remove the connector {{name}} from Claude Code?
health.failed: It did not work. See the details.

doctor.keyOk: API key saved in the secure keychain.
doctor.mcpAuthAccount: Needs to be authorised again on claude.ai.
doctor.mcpAuthLocal: Needs authentication: authorise it in Claude Code, or remove it.
doctor.mcpFailedAccount: Cannot connect: check it on claude.ai.
doctor.mcpFailedLocal: Cannot start. Updating Claude Code may help; otherwise remove it.

setup.gitLicense: Git will be installed from the Windows package catalog (winget). By confirming you accept the Git license (GPL v2).
setup.adminPrompt: Your system will ask for your password to install Git.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: A snapshot is taken before and after every task. You can go back to any point; your current files are saved first.
timeline.confirm: Put the project back to this point? Your current files are saved first, so you can undo it.
timeline.restored: Done. You can undo it from the timeline.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: Check a skill before installing it: Baguette reads every file without running anything and gives a trust score.
skills.blocked: Your security level does not allow this skill (minimum {{min}}/100).
skills.noSkillMd: No SKILL.md: this is not a skill.

night.title: Night pilot
night.intro: Prepare tasks during the day (answer the questions, check the quote), then choose “Add to the night” instead of running them. Tonight, start the queue: tasks run one after another, the pilot waits if your quota runs out and continues where it stopped, and a report is ready in the morning.
night.proOnly: The night pilot is part of Pro.
night.addHint: Run this task tonight instead of now
night.empty: Nothing queued yet. After a quote, choose “Add to the night”.
night.budgetHelp: Tasks that do not fit wait for another night. Your usual caps still apply.
night.stopAtHelp: No new task and no waiting after this time.
night.retry: If a criterion fails, try once more
night.keepOpen: Leave the app open (minimised is fine). The computer will not go to sleep; the screen can turn off.
night.paused: Quota used up: waiting until {{time}}, then continuing where it stopped.
night.pausesLine: Waited for the quota {{count}}× (last wait until {{time}}).
night.cancelled: Stopped before the end. Tasks not started are still in the queue.

note.over_budget: did not fit in the budget

freelance.title: Client of this project
freelance.intro: For freelancers: set your rate once per project. Each quote then shows the price to announce to the client, and every month you get an activity statement with the proof for each task.
freelance.proOnly: Freelance mode is part of Pro.
freelance.billAi: Re-invoice the AI cost to the client
freelance.subscriptionNote: With a subscription, the AI cost shown is its API value, not money you paid per task.
freelance.localOnly: These details stay on this computer.
freelance.statementHint: Finished tasks of the month. Click a time to enter the real time you spent.
freelance.proofNote: Proof: each line shows the success criteria checked automatically. Claude Code worked {{agent}} in total.
freelance.notInvoice: Activity statement, not an invoice: copy it into your invoicing tool.

demo.title: Share
demo.hint: An animated picture of this task: the request, the price, the result and the proof. Ready for a post, a README or a client. Made on this computer.
demo.quoteQuota: Quoted before starting: {{pct}} of the window

licence.title: Licence
licence.freeHint: The quote and the per-task cap stay free for life. Pro adds the proof, the retry, the night pilot, freelance mode and the rest.
licence.trialUsed: The free trial was already used on this computer.
licence.trialHint: Every Pro feature is on during the trial. No card was asked, nothing is charged at the end.
licence.removeConfirm: Free this computer's seat? You can activate the key again anywhere.
licence.activated: Pro is active on this computer.
licence.recoverSent: If this address bought a key, it is on its way.
licence.privacy: To check a licence, only an anonymous code of this computer is sent, never your files or your name.

error.offline: No connection to the licence server. Try again later.
error.server: The licence server did not answer properly. Try again later.
error.bad_key: This does not look like a key. Check it (PRO-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX).
error.unknown_key: Unknown key. Check it, or get it again by email.
error.too_many_devices: This key is already active on 3 computers. Remove it from one of them first.
error.revoked: This key was refunded or cancelled.
error.bad_email: This email address does not look right.
error.mail_unavailable: Sending keys by email is not available yet. Write to the support address on the website.

licence.earlyText: Every Pro feature is on, for everyone, at no cost, while the app is in early access. No account, no card, and the app sends nothing about you anywhere. A paid Pro plan will come later; the free version will stay free.

update.title: Updates
update.error: Could not check right now. Try again later.
update.signed: The app checks at start-up. Updates are signed: only a version published by the project can install.

ask.title: What do you want to know?
ask.placeholder: For example: where is the contact form handled? Why is the page slow on phones?
ask.hint: Claude Code only reads your project: nothing is changed. No brief and no checks, so it is fast and cheap.
ask.failed: No answer this time. Try asking more precisely.

followUp.title: Continue this task
followUp.hint: Ask for a change to what was just done. Claude Code picks up the same session, so it remembers the work and the brief stays short.
followUp.placeholder: For example: make the title bigger and add the Sunday hours.
